{
  "title": "Research Brief: De-homogenizing LLM Ideation",
  "bullets": [
    "Approach 1: Decoding-level interventions, such as contrastive decoding and dynamic temperature adjustments, push models beyond high-probability paths.",
    "Approach 2: Multi-agent debate frameworks and diverse persona ensembles force structural divergence during problem framing.",
    "Approach 3: Randomness injection via latent space perturbations or retrieval from niche, un-clustered corpora breaks semantic mode collapse.",
    "Limitation 1: High-entropy sampling frequently produces incoherent or nonsensical outputs rather than viable, novel concepts.",
    "Limitation 2: Persona-based prompting routinely degrades into surface-level caricatures, failing to generate deep cognitive diversity in benchmarked studies.",
    "Criticism: Mainstream RLHF alignment inherently penalizes non-conformity, prioritizing predictable consensus over radical, non-standard creative directions.",
    "Analogy: Similar to monoculture agriculture, optimizing LLMs strictly for likelihood creates a high-yield but highly vulnerable and uniform output ecosystem."
  ]
}
